overloads.semanticRole: QR REPORT prints a report for aTable , created with the Quick Report editor.

constraints: The Quick Report editor does not appear if the table has been declared "Invisible".

Relations between tables keep their manual status when the editor is invoked via QR REPORT; automatic relation propagation is disabled while related tables are shown in a list form (DISPLAY SELECTION / MODIFY SELECTION / subform).
QR ON COMMAND cannot be used in this context (the editor runs in an external window); use the methodName parameter instead to run custom code when an interface command is activated.
document must be a report document previously created and saved on disk with the Quick Report editor.
